metadata.title: Agent Assist
metadata.description: Text shortcuts for support agents — anywhere you type. Type / for permanent snippets or # for quick temp replies in any textarea across the web.

hero.title: Text shortcuts for support agents —
hero.description: Customer support, sales, and ops teams repeat the same messages all day. Agent Assist brings your approved replies into helpdesks, CRMs, chat widgets, and email — with / and # triggers. No tab switching. No clipboard gymnastics.
hero.footnote: Free & open source · Works on Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, and Firefox

features.title: Built for how support teams actually work
features.subtitle: Reply faster without leaving the ticket. Stay on-message across your whole team.

worksEverywhere.title: Works wherever you type
worksEverywhere.description: Insert replies directly in the field — no copy-paste, no tab switching. Zendesk, Intercom, Gmail, Salesforce, and your internal tools.

twoTriggers.title: Two triggers, two jobs
twoTriggers.description: /refund for team-approved replies you reuse every day. #quick for one-offs that stay out of your main library.

keyboardDropdown.title: Keyboard-first dropdown
keyboardDropdown.description: Type / or # and keep going — the menu narrows as you type. Arrow keys or 1–9 to pick, Enter or Tab to insert. Hands stay on the keyboard.

library.title: Organised snippet library
library.description: Group shortcuts into colour-coded categories — greetings, policies, closings. Browse, edit, and bulk-clear from accordion sidebars.

json.title: Share libraries as JSON
json.description: Export permanent and temp libraries separately. Hand off to teammates, restore backups, or ship starter packs to new agents.

safeImports.title: Safe imports
safeImports.description: Replacing existing shortcuts? You'll get a clear confirmation first — no silent overwrites, no accidental data loss.

testPanel.title: Test before you ship
testPanel.description: Try / and # triggers in the dashboard sandbox before they go live on a real customer ticket.

controls.title: You're in control
controls.description: Disable all shortcuts site-wide, or hide the dropdown while keeping quick insert. The toolbar icon shows exactly what's on.

themesLanguages.title: Themes & languages
themesLanguages.description: Light or dark UI. Six languages with full RTL — English (US/UK), Persian, Arabic, Turkish, and Kurdish.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get started in three simple steps

create.title: Create your shortcuts
create.description: Open dashboard, create categories, add permanent (/) or temp (#) shortcuts with your team's approved messages.

enable.title: Enable extension
enable.description: Toggle Extension on. Optionally enable dropdown for fuzzy-search menu.

use.title: Use anywhere
use.description: In any ticket, chat, or email field, type /refund or #quick — pick from menu or press Enter/Tab.

installation.title: Installation
installation.subtitle: Install from a release zip. Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons listings coming soon.
firefoxSteps: Select manifest.json inside unzipped Firefox build folder
Note: temporary add-ons removed when Firefox closes

metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: How Agent Assist handles your data. Local-first snippet storage, no analytics, and no data sold to third parties.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Agent Assist is a browser extension that expands text snippets while you type. We built it to be local-first: your shortcuts stay on your device, and we do not run servers that receive your data.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Agent Assist lets you create text shortcuts and insert them in textarea and rich-text fields across the web using / and # triggers.
This policy explains what the extension accesses, what it stores, and what we do not do with your information.

dataCollection.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: We do not collect, sell, or transmit your personal data to our servers. Agent Assist has no accounts, no analytics, and no remote backend.
Any information you enter — such as snippet text, category names, or shortcut labels — is created by you and stored locally in your browser.

localStorage.title: What is stored on your device
paragraphs: The extension uses the Chrome Storage API to save your snippet library, categories, on/off toggle, dropdown preference, UI theme, and language. Data is kept in chrome.storage.local on your device.
A small metadata copy may also be written to chrome.storage.sync so your settings can follow your signed-in Chrome profile. That sync is handled by Google as part of Chrome Sync — not by us.

pageAccess.title: Access to web page content
paragraphs: To provide snippet expansion, a content script runs on web pages where you type. It listens only in textarea and contenteditable fields.

The extension reads the text around your cursor to detect / or # triggers and to replace them with your saved snippet. This processing happens entirely on your device in real time. We do not log, store, or send the contents of your tickets, emails, or chats to any server.

noRemote.title: No remote code
paragraphs: All extension code is bundled in the package you install from the Chrome Web Store or GitHub release. Agent Assist does not load JavaScript from external URLs, use eval(), or execute code from outside the extension package.

thirdParties.title: Third parties
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with advertisers, data brokers, or other third parties.
The only external services involved are those provided by your browser vendor (for example, Chrome Sync if you enable it) and the Chrome Web Store for distribution and updates.

chromeSync.title: Chrome Sync
paragraphs: If you are signed into Chrome and have Sync enabled, snippet metadata and settings stored in chrome.storage.sync may be copied across your Chrome profile by Google. We do not control Chrome Sync. Review Google's privacy policy for how that service handles your data.

userControl.title: Your choices
paragraphs: You are in full control of your data:
items: Export your snippet library as JSON or Excel from the dashboard at any time.
Edit or delete individual shortcuts and categories in the dashboard.
Turn the extension off globally from the dashboard or toolbar icon.
Uninstall the extension to remove locally stored data from your browser.

children.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Agent Assist is a productivity tool for professionals and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy when the extension changes. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect the latest revision. Continued use of Agent Assist after changes means you accept the updated policy.
